asset_heavy.reason: Electronic marketplace and data business run on technology and offices; no plants or fleets needed to grow.

big_ticket.reason: Annual subscriptions, data licences and tiered listing fees are small, regular payments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Market data and compliance subscriptions and annual listing fees continue in downturns, though new listings may slow.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are small issuers, broker-dealers and data subscribers, not mainly large enterprises or government.

notes: Website text was unavailable; answers rely on prior knowledge of OTC Markets Group.

offers_products.reason: Sells market data licences and trading and compliance technology (OTC Link ATS), which are product-like offerings.

offers_services.reason: Operates the OTCQX, OTCQB and Pink markets, with trading venue and issuer services for listed companies.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its trading platform, market tiers and data technology, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largest revenue is annual fees from OTCQX/OTCQB issuers plus recurring market data licences.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Pays come from issuers, broker-dealers and data users; retail investors mostly use it free via brokers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are listed companies, broker-dealers and institutions buying market data and trading services.
